source_full_text: The steward was so much accustomed to hearing stories of no importance that he thought there was no use going further with this, But reported to the princess that the newcomers had nothing to tell. Did you question them all she said. Well, no not directly said he but the father said that none of them could tell me any more than he had done

reference_text: 仆人早已习惯听到那些无关紧要的故事，因此认为没必要再继续追问下去，便向公主报告说，新来的人没有什么可说的。你都问过他们了吗？她问道。嗯，没有，不是直接问的，他回答说，但那位父亲说，他们之中没有人能告诉我比他更多的事情。
